description: Source code for multiprocessing support in Zephyr OS for Intel ADSP cAVS hardware, including core startup, IPIs, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: soc_mp_startup
methods.description: Initializes multiprocessing on a given CPU, clears TFC high bits, and enables IRQ.

methods.name: soc_start_core
methods.description: Starts a core by setting up trampoline code, disabling power gating, and sending power-up message.

methods.name: arch_sched_ipi
methods.description: Sends inter-processor interrupts to other active CPUs.

methods.name: idc_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for IDC, handles IPIs and clears TFC bits.

methods.name: soc_mp_init
methods.description: Initializes multiprocessing, sets up IRQs, and clears pending interrupts.

methods.name: soc_adsp_halt_cpu
methods.description: Halts a specified CPU by masking interrupts and disabling power/clock gating.
